Member.name: Member
Member.description:
The workspace: issues, the conversation on them, and everything that has happened on a project.

It is also where the fleet becomes visible to a person. The activity feed is not only this service's own work —
when the documents service changes a file, that reaches here over the relay and shows up in the feed, which is why
`DocumentChanged` is declared below without this service ever raising it.

ProjectColor.name: ProjectColor
ProjectColor.description: The colour a project is known by, in the rail and on its page.

Project.name: Project
Project.description:
A project: what the rail lists and what issues, files and chat belong to. Its settings are the team's to change,
and one of them does work: a new issue opened without an assignee goes to the project's default one.

fields.name: defaultAssignee
fields.description: Who a new issue goes to when whoever opens it names nobody. Null: it stays with nobody.

fields.name: version
fields.description: Bumped on every change. Send it back as ifVersion so two people editing the settings cannot both win.

ProjectChanges.name: ProjectChanges
ProjectChanges.description: What to change on a project. Absent stays as it is; null clears the two that may be empty.

Priority.name: Priority
Priority.description: How soon. `urgent` sorts first on every screen; `normal` is what an issue gets unless someone says otherwise.

fields.name: title
fields.description: A client that predicts a rename keeps its word until the server answers.

fields.name: state
fields.description: A client that predicts a move gives way the moment the server says otherwise.

fields.name: labels
fields.description: Free text, as many as the project likes. Filter the list by one.

fields.name: dueOn
fields.description: The day it is due, if a day was set. Past it and not done is overdue.

fields.name: version
fields.description: Bumped on every change. Send it back as ifVersion so a move cannot land on top of someone else's.

fields.name: comments
fields.description: The conversation. Long and not for a list, so it arrives in a later frame unless a shape asks for it eagerly.

fields.name: attachments
fields.description: Documents from the documents service pinned to this issue. Loaded once for the whole page of issues.

Attachment.name: Attachment
Attachment.description:
A document attached to an issue. The document itself lives in the documents service; this is the link, with the name
and address the attacher was shown. A rename over there reaches here over the relay, the way the feed does, so the
name stays right without this service ever asking the other.

AgentToken.name: AgentToken
AgentToken.description: What an agent holds: a capability token for the same person, narrowed to the operations it names, and marked.

IssueChanges.name: IssueChanges
IssueChanges.description:
What to change on an issue. A field that is absent stays as it is; one that is sent replaces what was there, and null
clears the ones that may be empty. That is the protocol's rule for absent arguments (spec 03 §2), so a form sends
only what its person touched and two people editing different fields at once both land. Every field is nullable
here because a required one would have to be sent every time; the command refuses null on the three that cannot be
empty.

Workload.name: Workload
Workload.description: One person's share of a project's issues, for the people page.

fields.name: overdue
fields.description: Not done and past their due day.

Activity.name: Activity
Activity.description: One line of what has happened on a project, whichever service it happened in.

fields.name: source
fields.description: Which service this came from: `workspace`, or `documents` when it arrived over the relay.

fields.name: by
fields.description: Who did it. Absent when the line came from something no person did.

Message.name: Message
Message.description: A line in a project's chat: what someone said, when. The conversation nobody files an issue for.

Notification.name: Notification
Notification.description:
Something that happened to you: an issue handed over, a reply on one you hold, a file of yours made searchable.
Yours alone: the policy reads the recipient, so a notification is never seen by anyone else.

fields.name: readAt
fields.description: Null until it has been read.

Said.name: Said
Said.description: Raised when a message is said, so an open chat hears it as it happens.

Notified.name: Notified
Notified.description: Raised when a notification is written, carried to the one person it is for.

ActivityHappened.name: ActivityHappened
ActivityHappened.description: Raised here when anything lands on a project's feed, so a stream can carry it without polling the table.

DocumentChanged.name: DocumentChanged
DocumentChanged.description:
Raised by the **documents** service, not by this one. Declared here because the relay delivers events by name to
every service in the fleet, and this service reacts to it: a changed document becomes a line in the feed.

DocumentFiled.name: DocumentFiled
DocumentFiled.description: Three more of the documents service's, heard the same way: filed, tagged, and remarked on.

ApprovalRequested.name: ApprovalRequested
ApprovalRequested.description: The approvals service's, the fleet's JVM member: a sign-off asked, and one decided. Heard here the same way.

projects.name: projects
projects.description:
Every project, in the order the rail shows them. Also a plain GET on /projects for a page that keeps no Rayfold client — the shell reads
its rail from it.

updateProject.name: updateProject
updateProject.description: Change a project's settings. Send `ifVersion`: an edit on top of someone else's is refused.

members.name: members
members.description: Everyone who can be assigned something, for a picker.

me.name: me
me.description: Who is asking, as this service knows them: the session made a person, and this is that person's row.

mintAgentToken.name: mintAgentToken
mintAgentToken.description:
A token for a program acting as the caller: the same person, allowed only the operations named, for a while. It is
marked as an agent's, and an agent may not mint another: a token can be narrowed, never widened.

workload.name: workload
workload.description: How the work is spread over the team, across every project. Ask for it `live` and it follows each hand-over.

issues.name: issues
issues.description: A project's issues. Each filter narrows; none means all of them.

activity.name: activity
activity.description: What has happened on this project, newest first. Ask for it `live` and it stays current by itself.

createIssue.name: createIssue
createIssue.description: Open an issue. Of normal priority unless the arguments say otherwise, and with the project's default assignee when it names none.

updateIssue.name: updateIssue
updateIssue.description: Change an issue's fields. Send `ifVersion` as with a move; an edit on top of someone else's is refused.

assignIssue.name: assignIssue
assignIssue.description: Hand an issue to someone, or to nobody. Send `ifVersion` as with a move. Whoever it went to is notified.

moveIssue.name: moveIssue
moveIssue.description: Move an issue. Send `ifVersion` with the version you read and a move that would overwrite someone else's is refused.

attachDocument.name: attachDocument
attachDocument.description: Pin a document to an issue: the id, name and address the documents service gave it. Pinning it twice is once.

detachDocument.name: detachDocument
detachDocument.description: Unpin a document from its issue. Null when it was not pinned.

addComment.name: addComment
addComment.description: Reply on an issue. Whoever holds the issue is notified, unless the reply is theirs.

activityFeed.name: activityFeed
activityFeed.description: Every line as it lands, without polling. Carries what other services did, too.

messages.name: messages
messages.description: A project's chat so far, newest last.

say.name: say
say.description: Say something in a project's chat. Everyone with the chat open hears it through the stream.

chat.name: chat
chat.description: Each message as it is said, in order: what a chat is, rather than a list that re-runs.

unread.name: unread
unread.description: How many of yours are unread. Live, so a badge is right without asking again.

notified.name: notified
notified.description: Each notification for you, as it is written.

markRead.name: markRead
markRead.description:
Marks everything of yours up to a moment as read, and says how many that was. Doing it twice is the same as once by
its nature, so it takes no idempotency key — and refuses one, which is what @idempotent(false) means.
